description: This file implements a Windows-specific raster handle allocator for Skia, managing HDC and HBITMAP resources, creating platform canvases with shared memory, and handling GDI operations.

classes.name: GDIAllocator
classes.description: A subclass of SkRasterHandleAllocator that provides HDC handles for Skia raster operations.

methods.name: DeleteHDCCallback
methods.description: Callback to delete HDC and associated bitmap resources.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an HBITMAP and HDC for raster operations, optionally clearing the bitmap.

methods.name: allocHandle
methods.description: Allocates a handle (HDC) for a given SkImageInfo.

methods.name: updateHandle
methods.description: Updates the handle with a transformation matrix and clip bounds.

methods.name: unmap_view_proc
methods.description: Unmaps a view of shared memory.

methods.name: CreatePlatformCanvasWithSharedSection
methods.description: Creates a Skia canvas backed by shared memory, using GDI if available.

methods.name: GetNativeDrawingContext
methods.description: Retrieves the native HDC from a SkCanvas.
